# Draft:DAV Public School, Pokhariput, Bhubaneswar

DAV PUBLIC SCHOOL POKHARIPUT BHUBANESWAR
Affiliated to CBSE, New Delhi. (A Senior Secondary, Co-Educational School)Po- Aerodrome Area Bhubaneswar Odisha- 751020
Overview
DAV Public School, Pokhariput, established in 1992, is a co-educational institution affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi. Located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, the school operates under the aegis of the DAV College Trust and Management Society.
Campus and Facilities
The school is situated on a 5-acre campus, accommodating approximately 2,650 students. The infrastructure includes classrooms equipped with Smart Class audio-visual systems, laboratories, a library, an auditorium, sports facilities such as a basketball court, and green lawns. Additionally, the school houses an Atal Tinkering Lab, established under the initiative by NITI Aayog, to promote innovation and creativity among students.
Academic Achievements
The school has demonstrated commendable academic performance. In the CBSE Class XII examinations of 2024, student Priyasha Pattnaik secured 98.2% in the Commerce stream, emerging as the school topper. She also achieved an All India Rank of 103 in the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) 2024, securing admission to NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad.
Faculty Recognition
The school's faculty has been acknowledged for excellence in teaching. In 2021, teachers Sitikantha Pati and Smaranika Pattnaik were among 22 educators nationwide to receive the CBSE award for 'Excellence in Teaching and School Leadership 2020-21'. Each awardee received a certificate of commendation and a cash award of ₹50,000.
History
The school commenced its journey in 1992 with a modest setup of a few teachers and students. Over the years, it has grown into a prominent educational institution, catering to the academic needs of approximately 2,650 students.
Leadership
Dr. Sujata Sahu served as the principal of DAV Public School, Pokhariput, from 2001 until May 2023. She then assumed the role of Principal-cum-Assistant Regional Officer at DAV Public School, Chandrasekharpur.
Mr. Bipin Kumar Sahoo: As of March 2025, he is serving as the current principal of DAV Public School, Pokhariput.
Online Presence
The school maintains an active online presence, providing resources and updates through its official website and social media platforms. The library's website offers e-resources, news clippings, and a blog to engage students and staff.
